_comment: Proposed answers for the OpenSSF Best Practices badge, derived from evidence in this repository. Only criteria backed by a file or setting are listed; everything else is left for the maintainers to answer. Format: https://github.com/ossf/best-practices-badge/blob/main/docs/bestpractices-json.md
dependency_monitoring_justification: Composer Audit checks the dependencies against known vulnerabilities in CI and fails the job on any advisory it finds, so a vulnerable dependency has to be upgraded or explicitly handled before a change passes. If the advisory source stays unreachable after three attempts, the job passes with a visible warning that no audit took place: https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-bug-reporter/blob/main/.github/workflows/checks.yml (shared workflow: https://github.com/netresearch/typo3-ci-workflows/blob/main/.github/workflows/security.yml).
discussion_justification: GitHub issues and pull requests are public, searchable, addressable by URL and need no proprietary client: https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-bug-reporter/issues
floss_license_justification: Released under GPL-2.0-or-later, an OSI-approved licence: https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-bug-reporter/blob/main/LICENSE.txt
license_location_justification: The licence file is in the repository root: https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-bug-reporter/blob/main/LICENSE.txt
repo_distributed_justification: The repository uses git, hosted at https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-bug-reporter
repo_public_justification: The source repository is public on GitHub: https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-bug-reporter
repo_track_justification: Git records the author, date and change of every commit; the history is browsable at https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-bug-reporter/commits/main
report_archive_justification: Public bug reports and the responses to them stay searchable in the issue tracker: https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-bug-reporter/issues?q=is%3Aissue
report_process_justification: Bugs are reported through the GitHub issue tracker: https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-bug-reporter/issues
sites_https_justification: Every project site is served over HTTPS: the repository, https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-bug-reporter.
test_justification: The repository carries 3 PHPUnit test files under https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-bug-reporter/tree/main/Tests (3 unit). CI runs the unit suite on every pull request through https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-bug-reporter/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml, which calls the shared TYPO3 CI (https://github.com/netresearch/typo3-ci-workflows/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml) with `unit-test-command: vendor/bin/phpunit`.
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: CI runs the unit suite on every pull request through https://github.com/netresearch/t3x-nr-bug-reporter/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml, which calls the shared TYPO3 CI (https://github.com/netresearch/typo3-ci-workflows/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml) with `unit-test-command: vendor/bin/phpunit`.
